quality.numeric_confidence_policy: Secondary reproduction explicitly attributed to Environment Agency Pollution Inventory 2024 under OGL is capped at confidence 98 until the direct official raw facility row is read.
quality.official_identity_policy: Official permit/register/public-authority and Companies House evidence is confidence 100 for identity only and does not inflate secondary numeric confidence.
quality.year_column_policy: Flattened single-value rows in a 2024/2025 table are excluded from 2024 unless independent evidence resolves the year.
quality.duplicate_policy: Five permit searches and five permit+representative-exact-value searches returned no repository match before Part87.
quality.subset_policy: Renewable-fuel CO2 is a component/subset and must never be added to total CO2.
quality.raw_source_policy: Exact official 2024 PI ZIP asset was retried through bounded clients; payload remained unread, so direct-row count stays zero and no confidence inflation occurs.
